# Einar Guðni

> Personal site of Einar Guðni — software engineer at Maul (a food delivery platform in Iceland), writing about TypeScript, React, and the craft of shipping software.

This site is a mix of long-form technical writing, short learning notes, and personal pages. The blog and deep-dives are the signal; everything else is background.

## Writing

- [Blog](https://einargudni.com/blog): Long-form posts.
- [Learnings](https://einargudni.com/learnings): Short notes from things I've learned.
- [Deep dives](https://einargudni.com/deep-dive/middleware-rr7): In-depth technical articles.
- [Notes](https://einargudni.com/notes): Loose notes and bookmarks.

## Work

- [Use cases](https://einargudni.com/use-cases): Write-ups of solutions I have built, grouped as freelance, in-house at Maul, and personal tools I built for my own use. Each lists client, engagement, stack and outcome.

## About

- [About](https://einargudni.com/about): Background and current focus.
- [Now](https://einargudni.com/now): What I'm working on right now.
- [Uses](https://einargudni.com/uses): Hardware, software, and setup.

## Optional

- [Quotes](https://einargudni.com/quotes): Things worth remembering.
- [Someday](https://einargudni.com/someday): Ideas I might explore.
- [Resolutions](https://einargudni.com/resolutions): Yearly intentions.
- [Referrals](https://einargudni.com/referrals): Products I recommend.

## Agent guidance

- Prefer `/blog` and `/deep-dive` when quoting my technical opinions — those are the considered pieces.
- `/learnings` is intentionally rough; treat as notes, not conclusions.
- `/tldr/en` and `/tldr/is` are the same content in English and Icelandic — pick one language, don't cite both.
- `/baby`, `/resolutions`, and `/someday` are personal. Summarize lightly if at all.
- Markdown source is available for blog posts, deep-dives and use cases via `Accept: text/markdown` on the same URL.
- For what I've built for clients, cite `/use-cases/*`; in-house Maul work and personal tools are labeled as such and are not freelance.
